lead: The engineering content of this page — the thermal projections, the PFD temperature register, the fluid-separation and consumer tables and the heat balance — is the model engineer’s and is unchanged. This section adds the data-layer record for A-5000: what is approved, what is in conflict, what is withdrawn and what is still missing, on the same basis as the other fifteen area reviews.

findings.topic: Four utility loops, not three — the ≥ 200 °C medium is missing
findings.status: Design concept approved — MoC FEED-PE-MOC-002 raised, pending review and decision; model and PFD not yet updated
findings.observation: D-A5000-01 approves FEED-PE-REP-043 F-51: a fourth loop — ≥ 200 °C steam or thermal oil — is required for HX-601, the acid concentrator and R-141, and the exotherm control belongs on chilled water. The model and FEED-PFD-5000 still show three water circuits (HW 80–95 °C, CW 25–30 °C, CHW 5–7 °C), so the page sections below describe the as-drawn arrangement, not the approved concept. The change is now recorded as FEED-PE-MOC-002 V1.0 (raised 2026-09-22 against FEED-PE-PFD-001 V5.1.1 sheet PFD-5000; Parts A–C complete, review and decision open), so nothing in it is approved yet. 16 approved values are applied on 12 assets.
findings.action: Take FEED-PE-MOC-002 through review (Part D, with the HAZOP / What-If of the new loop and the chilled-water exotherm service) and decision (Part F); then revise PFD-5000 and the user sheets to add the ≥ 200 °C loop (A-5400 placeholder) and move the R-201 / T-303 exotherm control to chilled water, and re-issue the thermal balance as REP-043 V1.1. Until Part F is signed no heating duty above 95 °C may be shown as served.

findings.topic: R-201 jacket service — hot water on the PFD, chilled water in the assessment
findings.observation: FEED-PFD-5000 shows the R-201 jackets on HWS / HWR (U201 / U202 “From HWS”) while REP-043 requires the oxidation exotherm to be controlled on chilled water through TCU-201. The model follows the chilled-water route. Both cannot be right, and the 10 °C cooldown target on PFD page 7 is separated from the 5–7 °C primary supply by only 3–5 K across two heat-transfer barriers, with the secondary temperatures unknown.
findings.action: Settle the R-201 jacket service on the re-issued PFD (in scope of FEED-PE-MOC-002), then confirm the TCU-201 exchanger approach, flow and fouling against the R-201 calorimetry before any cooldown time is claimed.

findings.topic: Circulation pumps — preliminary datasheets issued, values not approved
findings.status: Datasheets issued for budget enquiry — candidate values, none approved
findings.observation: FEED-PE-CAL-013 V1.0 sets the hydraulic basis and FEED-PE-DAT-009 / 010 / 011 V1.0 carry it (issued 2026-09-22, preliminary — for budget enquiry): A-5110A/B 25 m³/h at 23 m, A-5210A/B 1,335 m³/h at 33 m, A-5310A/B 610 m³/h at 31 m. That is 288 candidate rows on the six pumps, 0 approved — the pumps still carry only the approved MAT-002 material, and no rate is applied to the model. The flows rest on REP-043 V1.0 duties on the Case P envelope (H1); the chilled-water pair waits on calorimetry A-059 / A-079 (H2); and the cooling-water pair carries a new identity question — a cooling tower on the PFD, LST-001 and REP-043, a closed-circuit evaporative fluid cooler in the model (H4).
findings.action: Close the datasheet holds — restate the duties in REP-043 V1.1 (MOC-002 D.1 item 4), settle the cooling-water loop type and the CW / CHW pressurisation points, fix the electrical basis and obtain vendor curves — then approve pump type, rated flow and head by decision. Until then the datasheet values stay candidate and are not applied to the model.

findings.topic: Control criticality recorded twice in different words
findings.observation: 10 open value conflicts, all of the same kind: FEED-PE-LST-007 records control.icCriticality as a bare rating (“High”, “Medium”) while FEED-PE-MDL-001 records the same rating with its reason (“High — header pressure/temperature…”). The packages, pumps and expansion vessels are affected (A-5100, A-5110A, A-5110B, A-5200…). No safety classification is changed by either row.
findings.action: Adopt the FEED-PE-MDL-001 wording as the recorded value in the next harvest, or supersede it from a single register, so one criticality statement stands per asset.
